03 / Asia World MUN 8 · UNICEF Committee

From Mumbai to Bali.

I represented India at the 8th Asia World Model United Nations conference in Bali, serving on the UNICEF committee. I debated children's rights, explored global policies, and learned how diplomacy, negotiation, and decision-making work. More than anything, it taught me how to listen, question, and stand up for something I believe in.
